लभ् {c1c} A. (लभते, लेभे, अलब्ध,
लप्स्यते, लब्धुं, लब्ध)
1 To get, obtain,
gain, acquire; लभेत सिकतासु तैलमपि
यत्नतः पीडयन्

; चिराय
याथार्थ्यमलंभि दिग्गजैः Śi. 1. 64.
--2 To
have, possess, be in possession
of.
--3 To take, receive.
--4 To
catch, take or catch hold of;

.
--5 To find, meet with;
यत्किंचिल्लभते पथि.
--6 To recover, regain.
--7 To
know, learn, perceive, understand;
भ्रमणं… गमनादेब लभ्यते Bhāṣā

.
--8
To be able or be permitted (to do a
thing) (with inf.); मर्तुमपि न
लभ्यते; नाधर्मो-लभ्यते कर्तुं लोके वैद्याधरे.
(The senses of लभ् are modified
according to the noun with which it
is used; i. e. गर्भं लभ् to conceive,
[]
become pregnant; पदं or आस्पदं लभ्
to gain a footing, take a hold on;
see under पद; अंतरं लभ् to get a
footing, enter into; लेभेंऽतरं चेतसि
नोपदेशः

‘was not
impressed on the mind;’ चेतनां, --संज्ञां, --लभ्
to regain one's consciousness; जन्म
लभ् to be born;

; स्वास्थ्यं
लभ् to enjoy ease, be at ease; दर्शनं
लभ् to get an audience of &c.).
--Caus. (लंभयति-ते)
1 To cause to
get or receive, cause to take;

.
--2 To give, confer or
bestow upon; मोदकशरावं माणवकं
लंभय

.
--3 To cause to suffer.
--4 To obtain, receive.
--5 To find
out, discover. --Desid. (लिप्सते) To^1
wish to get, long for; अलब्धं चैव
लिप्सेत

.
[1] Correction submitted by user chandrasekharanr on 20190706.

लभनं [लभ्-ल्युट्]
1 The act of
getting, obtaining &c.
--2 Act of
conceiving.

1 Wealth, riches.
--2 One
who solicits, a solicitor.
--सं A rope
for tying a horse. (--m. also).

लभ्य a. [लभ्-कर्मणि यत्]
1
Capable of being acquired or obtained,
attainable, obtainable, to be
reached; प्रांशुलभ्ये फले मोहादुद्बाहुरिव वामनः

.
--3 Fit,
suitable, proper.
--4 Intelligible.
--5 To be furnished or provided
with.

लाभः [लभ्-भावे घञ्]
1 Gaining,
obtaining, acquirement, acquisition;
शरीरत्यागमात्रेण शुद्धिलाभममन्यत

.
--3
Enjoyment.
--4 Capture, conquest.
--5
Perception, knowledge,
apprehension.
--Comp.
--कर, --कृत् a.
profitable, advantageous.
--लिप्सा desire
of gain, avarice, covetousness.
--लिप्सु a. {1} greedy, covetous. {2}
desirous of gain.
